8.5.4.6 IocEmptyQueue
[SWS_Os_00754] Definition of API function IocEmptyQueue_<IocId>
Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_80020
⌈
Service Name
IocEmptyQueue_<IocId>
Syntax
Std_ReturnType IocEmptyQueue_<IocId> (
void
)
Service ID [hex]
0x26
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non reentrant
Parameters (in)
None
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
IOC_E_OK: Content of the queue was successfully deleted
Description
In case of queued communication identified by the <IocId> in the function name, the content of
the IOC internal communication queue shall be deleted.
Available via
Ioc.h
⌋
General:
[SWS_Os_00755]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_80020
⌈The function IocEmptyQueue_<IocId> shall be present for all IOC elements with
queued semantics.⌋
[SWS_Os_00756]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_80020
⌈The function IocEmptyQueue_<IocId> shall delete all contents from the associated
data queue.
The IocEmptyQueue should be generated in a more efficient way than an iterative
call to an IocReceive function.⌋
